head_commit.message:
Repair coordinate proof elaboration reported by CI165

Fix explicit radial projection types, root-power rewrite aliases, positive chart simplification and radial principal formulas. Preserve the exact derivative tower when transporting primitive jet certificates through normalization. Use the neighboring compiled transparency policy and typed witness projections for the two large-bound elaboration timeouts.

Seven source files; no public statement, import, provider, workflow, generator or resource-limit changes. Net +44 lines; conservative distance from full-green c796 is 19890 added Lean lines.

Exact repair plan: 1b61b8c9792937ad999dcb4fe35e7ffe9a1441c4. N04Coordinates Realization remains open.
